sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 42 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

measurement.note: Road-limit estimates from sparse visible curb, paint and asphalt-edge positions on the pinned LGLN DOP20 image. Centre-point inventory identifies the Meppen flight of 8 March 2025; it does not date every pixel. Positions outside the eastern junction were fitted to the visible road and then screened at native scale, with approximately 9 m anchor spacing. The paired coordinates define road cross-sections independently of the coarse source normals, without changing the original trace. Virtual limits across the southern merge and eastern branch opening follow adjoining visible edge directions; they are route-selection estimates rather than observed physical curbs. At the eastern chicane, the outer edge follows the paint triangle to its west tip, then interpolates across the gap to the return-island edge; virtual coordinates at 450/452 and 464/466/468 and inner 460–468 are fitted join controls, not additional edge observations. Intervals and junctions remain estimates, banking is unknown and rendered curbs illustrative. Raster output spacing is not survey accuracy. Redundant paired controls were removed only where the complete reconstructed edge changes by at most 0.10 m. Junction controls are retained; straight gaps remain at most 50 m.

borderInference.note: Road-border estimates reconstructed from complete pairs of sparse image-edge measurements. Each pair defines its own road section; the original trace is preserved and constrains station displacement and route order. Linear intervals, junction openings and curbs remain estimates, not surveyed racing limits. Every saved edge station and anchor requires pinned-image coverage during authoring. No automatic evidence scores are claimed.
